48.original: Greetings, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. No pressing emergencies at the moment, but the infirmary could use a hand if you're willing.

49.original: There's a problem with bugs, you sssee─the biting, ssstinging kind. Our sssentries finish their watches covered in weltsss, and we cannot ignore the effect thisss may have on morale.

50.original: Even the ssstrongest incense won't keep all the insssects away, but mudssstone can be ground into a passste that sssoothes the worssst of the itching. Might you bring me three or ssso chunksss? You'll find despositsss of the ssstuff in the waters of Mirage Creek.

51.original: Were you able to locate any mudssstone depositsss?

52.original: Yesss, these should do nicely. Once applied, the balm worksss to alleviate any irritation almossst immediately.

53.original: It is a traditional remedy of ours, passed down through generations.

54.original: We do alssso have an alchemical sssalve made by your people which heals the bites themssselves, but it is in short sssupply. I would rather sssave it for the mossst sssevere cases, and rely on mudssstone for daily use.
